11737-barks-and-purrs.title: Barks And Purrs
11737-barks-and-purrs.creator: Unknown
11737-barks-and-purrs.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. id-Summer, is not worth the starched manner, that old magistrate de Vigny--with his neckcloth wound three times around, and rigid in his trousers' straps--imposed upon his goddesses? Madame Colette Willy is a live woman, a real woman, who has dared to be natural and who resembles a little village bride far more than a perverse woman of letters_.

arxiv-2112-02596.title: T ​ T ¯ T{\bar{T}} and Holography
arxiv-2112-02596.creator: Asrat Demisē
arxiv-2112-02596.description: Abstract In recent years, there have been two independent but related developments in the study of irrelevant deformations in two dimensional quantum field theories (QFTs). The first development is the deformation of a two dimensional QFT by the determinant of the energy momentum stress tensor, commonly referred to as T ​ T ¯ T{\bar{T}} deformation.

arxiv-2302-00982.title: Stochastic optimal transport in Banach Spaces for regularized estimation of multivariate quantiles Thanks: The authors gratefully acknowledge financial support from the Agence Nationale de la Recherche (MaSDOL grant ANR-19-CE23-0017). Jérémie Bigot is a member of Institut Universitaire de France (IU
arxiv-2302-00982.creator: Bernard Bercu, Jérémie Bigot and Gauthier Thurin
arxiv-2302-00982.description: Abstract . We introduce a new stochastic algorithm for solving entropic optimal transport (EOT) between two absolutely continuous probability measures μ \mu and ν \nu . Our work is motivated by the specific setting of Monge-Kantorovich quantiles where the source measure μ \mu is either the uniform distribution on the unit hypercube or the spherical uniform distribution.

arxiv-2312-16036.title: Ensemble Learning to Assess Dynamics of Affective Experience Ratings and Physiological Change Thanks: All authors contributed equally to this work.
arxiv-2312-16036.creator: Felix Dollack 1 , Kiyoshi Kiyokawa 1 , Huakun Liu 1 , Monica Perusquia-Hernandez 1 , Chirag Raman 2 , Hideaki Uchiyama 1 , Xin Wei 1
arxiv-2312-16036.description: Abstract The congruence between affective experiences and physiological changes has been a debated topic for centuries. Recent technological advances in measurement and data analysis provide hope to solve this epic challenge. Open science and open data practices, together with data analysis challenges open to the academic community, are also promising tools for solving this problem.

arxiv-2401-07468.title: CarSpeedNet: A Deep Neural Network-based Car Speed Estimation from Smartphone Accelerometer
arxiv-2401-07468.creator: Barak Or
arxiv-2401-07468.description: Abstract We introduce the CarSpeedNet , a deep learning model designed to estimate car speed using three-axis accelerometer data from smartphones. Using 13 hours of data collected from a smartphone in cars across various roads, CarSpeedNet accurately models the relationship between smartphone acceleration and car speed. Ground truth speed data was collected at 1 [Hz] from GPS receivers.

arxiv-2401-17263.title: Robust Prompt Optimization for Defending Language Models Against Jailbreaking Attacks
arxiv-2401-17263.creator: Andy Zhou Bo Li Haohan Wang
arxiv-2401-17263.description: Abstract Despite advances in AI alignment, large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks or jailbreaking, in which adversaries can modify prompts to induce unwanted behavior. While some defenses have been proposed, they have not been adapted to newly proposed attacks and more challenging threat models.

arxiv-2509-01391.title: MixedG2P-T5: G2P-free Speech Synthesis for Mixed-script texts using Speech Self-Supervised Learning and Language Model
arxiv-2509-01391.creator: Joonyong Park ∗, Daisuke Saito ∗, Nobuaki Minematsu ∗ \authorblockA \authorrefmark 1 The University of Tokyo, Japan E-mail: {jpark, dsk_saito, mine}@gavo.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp
arxiv-2509-01391.description: Abstract This study presents a novel approach to voice synthesis that can substitute the traditional grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) conversion by using a deep learning-based model that generates discrete tokens directly from speech. Utilizing a pre-trained voice SSL model, we train a T5 encoder to produce pseudo-language labels from mixed-script texts (e.g., containing Kanji and Kana).

arxiv-2601-12491.title: Vastu : V alue- A ligned S ocial T oolkit for Online Content C u ration
arxiv-2601-12491.creator: Agam Goyal, Xianyang Zhan, Charlotte Lambert, Koustuv Saha, Eshwar Chandrasekharan
arxiv-2601-12491.description: Abstract Detecting what content communities value is a foundational challenge for social computing systems—from feed curation and content ranking to moderation tools and personalized recommendation systems. Yet existing approaches remain fragmented across methodological paradigms, and it remains unclear which methods best capture community-specific notions of value.

arxiv-2602-07191.title: HALO: A Fine-Grained Resource Sharing Quantum Operating System
arxiv-2602-07191.creator: John Zhuoyang Ye, Jiyuan Wang, Yifan Qiao, Jens Palsberg
arxiv-2602-07191.description: Abstract As quantum computing enters the cloud era, thousands of users must share access to a small number of quantum processors. Users need to wait minutes to days to start their jobs, which only takes a few seconds for execution.

europmc-pmc9221336.creator: Nassir F.
europmc-pmc9221336.description: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), recently renamed metabolic-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD), is one of the most common causes of liver diseases worldwide. NAFLD is growing in parallel with the obesity epidemic. No pharmacological treatment is available to treat...

pmc-10559111.title: Inversion of soil heavy metals in metal tailings area based on different spectral transformation and modeling methods
pmc-10559111.creator: Nannan Yang, Ling Han, Ming Liu
pmc-10559111.description: The exploitation of mineral resources has seriously polluted the environment around mines, notably in terms of heavy metal contamination of tailings pond soil. Hyperspectral remote sensing, as opposed to conventional on-site sampling and laboratory analysis, offers a potent tool for effective monitoring the content of soil heavy metals.

pmc-10560627.title: Adaptation and Implementation of Pictorial Conversation Aids for Early-Stage Breast Cancer Surgery and Reconstruction: A Quality Improvement Study
pmc-10560627.creator: Marie-Anne Durand, Marie Bannier, Marie-Anastasie Aim, Julien Mancini
pmc-10560627.description: PurposeAfter a diagnosis of early-stage breast cancer, women of lower socioeconomic position (SEP) report worse outcomes than women of higher SEP. A pictorial conversation aid was shown to improve decision outcomes in controlled contexts. No such intervention existed in France.

pmc-11359206.title: Eddy Current Sensor Probe Design for Subsurface Defect Detection in Additive Manufacturing
pmc-11359206.creator: Heba E. Farag, Mir Behrad Khamesee, Ehsan Toyserkani
pmc-11359206.description: Pore and crack formation in parts produced by additive manufacturing (AM) processes, such as laser powder bed fusion, is one of the issues associated with AM technology. Surface and subsurface cracks and pores are induced during the printing process, undermining the printed part durability.

pmc-11548178.title: Geodesic-Based Maximal Cliques Search for Non-Rigid Human Point Cloud Registration
pmc-11548178.creator: Shuwei Gan, Guangsheng Xu, Sheng Zhuge, Guoyi Zhang, Xiaohu Zhang, Shuo Shi
pmc-11548178.description: Non-rigid point cloud registration holds significant importance for human body pose analysis in the fields of sports, medicine, gaming, etc. In this paper, we propose a non-rigid point cloud registration algorithm based on geodesic distance measurement, which can improve the accuracy of the registration for matching point pairs during non-rigid deformations.

pmc-12515588.title: Branched-Chain Amino Acids and Testosterone in Older Adults With Type 2 Diabetes: Cross-Sectional and Longitudinal Findings From a Post Hoc Analysis of an Amino Acid Supplementation Trial
pmc-12515588.creator: Erika Matsuda, Takaaki Matsuda, Kosuke Kojo, Yoshinori Osaki, Yasuhiro Suzuki, Hiroaki Suzuki, Bryan Mathis, Motohiro Sekiya, Hiroyuki Nishiyama, Hitoshi Shimano
pmc-12515588.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Introduction: Branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs) and sex hormones share anabolic effects on skeletal muscle. As cross-sectional associations in older adults with type 2 diabetes (T2D) remain unclear, we analyzed potential causal effects of BCAA supplementation in this population.Methods: This was an exploratory, post hoc analysis of a 24-week amino acid supplementation trial in older adults with T2D (BCAA 8 g or soy protein 7.5 g). Thirty-five participants (22 men, 13 women) were included.

pmc-12659318.title: Three ethical approaches to expanding newborn screening through genomics: a critical comparative analysis
pmc-12659318.creator: Gabriel Watts, Margaret Otlowski, Robin Banks, Ainsley J. Newson
pmc-12659318.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe expansion of newborn bloodspot screening (NBS) programs through genomic sequencing is proposed as a way to revolutionise infant and lifelong healthcare. But for all its promise, profound ethical challenges arise too.

pmc-12985602.title: Can Progressive Strength Training Counteract Frailty and Improve Short-Term Autonomic Compensatory Responses During Active Standing Orthostatic Stress? A Pilot Study
pmc-12985602.creator: Dihogo Gama de Matos, Jefferson Lima de Santana, Felipe J. Aidar, Stephen M. Cornish, Gordon G. Giesbrecht, Albená Nunes-Silva, Roman Romero-Ortuno, Todd A. Duhamel, Rodrigo Villar
pmc-12985602.description: Background: Frailty is a multifactorial condition that significantly impacts older adults’ health and independence, which can be mitigated through training. This study examined the effects of a 12-week progressive strength training (PST) program on frailty status and short-term autonomic compensatory responses during postural transitions.

pmc-13223127.title: Tumor stage-dependent expression of autophagy proteins in adrenocortical carcinoma
pmc-13223127.creator: Sofia B. Oliveira, Diana Sousa, Madalena Costa, Elisabete Rios, Tiago Nunes da Silva, Valeriano Leite, Sofia S. Pereira, Duarte Pignatelli
pmc-13223127.description: IntroductionAdrenocortical carcinoma (ACC) is a rare endocrine malignancy with poor yet heterogeneous prognosis, mostly due to its complex and incompletely understood molecular background. Autophagy is a multi-step catabolic process with a dual role in tumorigenesis, acting either as a tumor suppressor or promoter in a context-dependent manner.

pmc-13554612.title: Single-cell expression quantitative trait locus Mendelian randomization reveals immune cell-specific causal regulatory networks and actionable targets in polycystic ovary syndrome
pmc-13554612.creator: Jiahuan Zhang, Yikai Liu, Danhong Lin, Dexia Li, Haoyi Liang, Wei Jin, Huibiao Quan
pmc-13554612.description: ObjectiveTo systematically investigate whether the pathogenesis of polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is causally related to dysregulated gene expression in specific immune cell subsets, and to evaluate the potential of these causal genes as actionable drug targets.MethodsThis study employed a two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) framework using publicly available genome-wide association study (GWAS) summary statistics.

pmc-13591093.title: Beyond the tumor microenvironment: a hierarchical immune-circuit model of immune checkpoint blockade resistance
pmc-13591093.creator: Xue Zhao, Han Wang, Yanan Liu, Lanqing Cao
pmc-13591093.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) produces durable tumor control in a subset of patients, yet resistance is usually interpreted through tumor-intrinsic lesions or suppression within the tumor microenvironment (TME). We propose that ICB resistance can also be organized as failure of a multiscale antitumor immune circuit comprising local immune execution, regional immune education in tumor-draining lymph nodes (TDLNs), and systemic immune calibration by the host.
